test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.pre_condition: A student with the email 'student_newuser@example.com' is logged into the system. A course titled 'Introduction to Software Engineering' exists and has a scheduled live session. The teacher has already started the live video session.
test_cases.expected_result: The student successfully joins the live video session. Video and audio streaming are active, and the student is able to see and hear the teacher, send and receive chat messages, and view connected participants. The system displays the video session screen.
test_cases.post_condition: The student is actively participating in the live video session, with video and chat functionalities available.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the 'Course List' to navigate to the Course Details Page.
Click on the 'Session Link' to join the live video session.
